name: db-client
description: Browse and query SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis and MongoDB from a DATABASES section: schema tree, a query tab with a results grid, a Redis key browser and a MongoDB query bar. Connections are read-only until you make them writable, enforced on the server; passwords go to Perch's secret store. Suggests connections from your project's .env.

dbClient.rowLimit.description: The most rows (or documents) a query shows.

dbClient.timeoutSeconds.description: How long (seconds) a query may run before it's stopped on the database server.
